forum.title: Request for HBM and CDM Information for Four Products
forum.best_answer_content:
The community will probably not be able to answer the questions about your four devices, so it would be better for you to create a ticket with the personal [Online Support OLS](https://ols.st.com).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
Dear All,

Could you please provide the HBM and CDM level for the below four products?

1. M95320-DRMN3TP/K

2. STPS15H100CBY-TR

3. STPS3150UY

4. STPS1H100AY

We were unable to find this information in the datasheets.

For other parts (e.g., MCUs), these values are typically specified,

but they do not appear to be listed for these products.

I would appreciate your support in sharing this information.

Best regards,

Rei.
